title: This Shrimp's Claw Snap Is Louder Than a Gunshot

scenes.text: This shrimp snaps its claw and makes a sound louder than a gunshot.
The claw closes so fast it shoots a jet of water at about 60 miles an hour.
That jet makes a bubble that collapses with a bang.
The shock wave is strong enough to stun or kill a small fish.
Louder than a gunshot. From a shrimp.

description:
A pistol shrimp snaps its claw with a bang louder than a gunshot.
The water jet hits about 60 miles an hour and the collapsing bubble can stun a small fish.
Could you hear it underwater?
first_comment: A shrimp this small makes a sound this loud. What's the loudest animal you know?
